note: Lean's `Duet` runs from a reference level k to an arbitrary end level o <= N with the coordinate zero at k, as in M, and the start enters as the number `w`; there is no separate E'' notation and the displayed bound is stated for the cost, from which the coordinate bound follows.

snippet.text:
theorem cone_cost {W : Worth} {H : History G} (hC : roomCost H.levels W) (hbank : Bank W H.levels)
    {F : Labels.Frame G d} {B : SectionData F} {A : Hol G} {N p k o : ℕ}
    {P : Duet H F N p k o} {w : ℝ} (hP : Duet.Woke P A W B w)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : k ≤ i) (hi' : i ≤ o) :
    32*(1+(H.levels.params i).columns)^2 * F.coeffSize (P.voice i).x ≤ P.cost i ∧
    gainChart H o i * P.cost i ≤ P.cost o := by

proof_context.conclusion: For any level `o <= N` and start `k <= i <= o`, the cost satisfies `gainChart o i * cost i <= cost o` and bounds the coordinate.

snippet.text:
theorem cost_finest {W : Worth} {H : History G} (hC : roomCost H.levels W) (hbank : Bank W H.levels)
    {F : Labels.Frame G d} {B : SectionData F} {A : Hol G} {N p k o : ℕ}
    {P : Duet H F N p k o} {w : ℝ} (hP : Duet.Woke P A W B w) :
    P.cost o ≤ 2*(1+(H.levels.params o).columns)*w := by
  have hh := (cone_cost hC hbank hP o hP.basic.1 le_rfl).1

proof_context.conclusion: `cost o <= 2(1+C_o) w` for the starting data `w` at level `o`.
